svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Two hosts. VM A on host 1 sends to VM B on host 2. The VM hook adds an outer IPv6 header for host 2, WireGuard encrypts it and sends it as UDP over the provider private network, and host 2 decrypts and unwraps it for VM B. The packet strip shows the headers at each step.

text.tspan: layer 3 · mesh · what the VMs see
layer 1 · provider network · the real wire
